episodes.synopsis: The road is in heavy traffic. The emergency molcar carrying the patient cannot move either. What can Potato do?!
episodes.title: Who Caused the Traffic Jam?

episodes.synopsis: A bank robber took over Shiromo?! The chase begins...!?
episodes.title: Catch the Bank Robber!

episodes.synopsis: A hot summer day. Abbey stops at a restaurant and there is still a driver's cat inside...! She has to save the cat from heat stroke!
episodes.title: Cat Rescue Operation

episodes.synopsis: Teddy eats the trash that the drivers litter. The driver gets carried away and starts throwing away more and more garbage while driving. However...
episodes.title: Chewing Chewing Cleaning

episodes.synopsis: Molecars' race.  Actually, there are a lot of traps on the course... Take your positions and let the race begin!
episodes.title: Pui Pui Racing

episodes.synopsis: Shiromo and Teddy escape from zombies! If you arm yourself and chase after the zombies, you will end up with a Hamburger Molcar. The two zombies fight for a rolled hamburger...
episodes.title: Zombie and Lunch

episodes.synopsis: A Molcar comes back from an adventure. Its body is covered with mud. How does the Molcar want to be cleaned?
episodes.title: It's a Prank? It's Sparkling Clean!

episodes.synopsis: Rescue the trapped Molcar! Incoming pursuers! Missiles! Big explosions!? A giant action spectacle!
episodes.title: Mol Mission

episodes.synopsis: On a snowy day, the Molcars can't run well. Then, a man is about to propose! The curtain rises on the Molcar musical!
episodes.title: Sliding Surprise

episodes.synopsis: Abbey longs to be a hero. On the day she got her beginner's mark, which was her long-cherished desire, she was made into an itasha of a beautiful girl character. Abbey is depressed, but then she sees a kitten who can't get down from a tree!
episodes.title: I Want to Be a Hero

episodes.synopsis: The Time Molcar, developed by the doctor, comes to the age of dinosaurs. When he is almost attacked by cavemen, he is met by... the ancestor of the Molcars?
episodes.title: Time Molcar

episodes.synopsis: Once the driver is asleep, the night belongs to the Molcars. Patrol Molcar and DJ Molcar have arrived, and everyone is here! Let's Molcar Party!
episodes.title: Let's! Molcar Party!
